waves.description: Build the four smallest independent product slices needed by the core hackathon journey.

tasks.title: Build fixture-only private sharing and consent
tasks.spec: Implement a fresh credential-free Fixture flow through public module ports: create one self-only private message, produce a bounded deterministic signal draft, and let only the same active speaker explicitly share it to an allowed visibility. Do not call an external provider or accept caller-controlled prompt metadata. Unsupported free-form provider behavior must return blocked or needs_human_review. Recheck actor, space, evidence ownership, consent, and visibility before the shared write. Private-message reads remain self-only even when another role guesses an identifier. Keep raw private content out of shared rows, reports, logs, and errors.
acceptance: The task starts from the exact accepted MVP-BASE-001 SHA, contains HAND-001 as an ancestor, and contains no failed Attempt ancestor

tasks.title: Build persisted five-stage responsibility reporting
tasks.spec: Implement a fresh deterministic responsibility capability through public module ports. Do not use an LLM for the MVP report or infer ownership from prose at report time. Exclude discussion-only, missing-evidence, denied, and needs-review inputs.
acceptance: The task starts from the exact accepted MVP-BASE-001 SHA, contains HAND-001 as an ancestor, and contains no failed Attempt ancestor
